Highlights: Gram Panchayat finances strengthened during 2022-23 and 2023-24; they, however, remain dependent on intergovernmental transfers, accounting for about 90 per cent of total receipts, while own source revenues (OSR) accounted for a modest share of about 10 per cent, predominantly driven by non-tax receipts such as interest receipts, Panchayati Raj programme funds and user charges.
